BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald Reilly have the pleasure of offering this wonderful 4 bedroom detached residence situated on a delightful, mature site in an ultra-convenient, yet private, setting convenient to Prosperous village and all amenities. 
This beautiful, light filled home has been lovingly maintained to ensure comfortable modern living where the décor is warm and inviting blending well with the overall feel of the house.
The accommodation is generous throughout with bright airy rooms positioned to maximize sunlight, and a south facing family room and garden. There are large living spaces and spacious bedrooms with an efficient layout throughout.
Outside is a wide, roomy garden to the rear, and a large tarmac drive to the front with mature trees and bushes that provide a sequence of colour during the growing season.
All the excellent amenities of Prosperous village are in close proximity including fine schools, churches and transport links, with a bus stop directly outside the house.
Viewing is highly recommended for those searching for a unique home with undoubted charm and quality in a convenient setting that is second to none.
